g.title: seq
g.text: 01b Investment programming: how a project enters the PIP and TRIP and reaches the budget

a.text: 1. PIP and TRIP secretariats to National
agency: Joint call to update the PIP and
formulate the TRIP, with guidelines and
calendar
2. Operating units to Regional Development
Councils: Regional priority programs and
projects
3. Regional Development Councils to Operating
units: Endorsement, or recommendations
4. National agency to PIPOL: Reconfirm ongoing
programs and projects. Encode new or updated
ones: cost per year, physical and financial
progress
5. National agency to PIPOL: Head of agency
endorses the submission (example window: 8
November to 6 December 2024)
6. PIPOL to PIP and TRIP secretariats: Only
submissions marked "as endorsed" are processed
7. PIP and TRIP secretariats: Check each entry
against the PIP criteria and the scope of the
TRIP
8. National agency to ICC: Project proposal
with feasibility study and financing plan
12. PIP and TRIP secretariats to DBM: PIP and
TRIP as input to budget preparation
9. ICC: Technical, economic and financial
appraisal
10. ICC to ED Council: Recommendation
11. ED Council to National agency: Approval or
confirmation

a.xlink:title: end of: Project needs ICC review

a.text: 13. DBM to National agency: Budget Call. A
Tier 2 proposal must be implementation-ready
and must have the required endorsements and
approvals
14. National agency to DBM: Tier 2 proposals
in OSBPS (a different system from PIPOL)
15. National agency to PIPOL: After the budget
is known, update yearly costs to match the GAA
and the National Expenditure Program
